bios.source: Third-party guides agree on these (we couldn't open Instagram's or TikTok's own help pages, 2026-10-20): check the counter in the app.

disclosure.title: Say it in the post too
disclosure.text: Tell people in the post itself, out loud and on screen, with plain words like "ad" or "sponsored", near the start. Don't count on the platform's label alone, and don't bury it in hashtags or the description.

disclosure.title: YouTube: mark paid promotion
disclosure.text: When a video has a paid promotion, say so as you upload: Show more, then Paid promotion. Viewers see a label when the video starts.

disclosure.title: TikTok: turn on the content disclosure
disclosure.text: Before you post a sponsored video, turn on the commercial content disclosure setting so TikTok labels it.

disclosure.title: Free products count too
disclosure.text: A free product, a discount or an affiliate link is a connection you disclose, the same as payment.

groups: Read the group's rules first. Many ban links or self-promotion; some allow it one day a week.
Give something useful in the post itself. The link is a small line at the end, or left out where links aren't allowed.
Answer every comment the same day.
Ask a moderator first if you're not sure.
